title: AI generated CGI trailer
author: bestof-games
selftext: What do you think of my CGI trailer? Used blender, opus 5.5 and \~3h of rendering time.

comments.author: Successful_Sink_1936
comments.body: animation is good but ahhhhh my eyes

comments.author: YaygFX
comments.body: I was ready to shit on this but honestly looks pretty cool! Nice trailer too.

comments.author: thesmithchris
comments.body: Looks nice! What was the process of making it?

replies.author: bestof-games
replies.body: I just told Claude I want a cool looking CGI trailer :) it reused game assets and rendered it using blender.

replies.author: thesmithchris
replies.body: :D did it do the robot model & animations as well or was the robot animated/made before?

replies.author: bestof-games
replies.body: It did everything by itself. All using blender. No meshy oder other mesh generation model was used.

replies.author: bestof-games
replies.body: It even rigged the model by itself. It was a one-shot.

comments.author: bestof-games
comments.body:
Here is the TestFlight invite, I appreciate all feedback. 

https://testflight.apple.com/join/QGMY7CtU

comments.author: DoctaRoboto
comments.body: Looks very cool, but is this a real game? I mean, the gameplay part of this is all fake, like those Chinese crappy fake ads?

replies.author: bestof-games
replies.body:
The game is very real. More like the trailer is “fake”.  You can test it on iOS here: 

https://testflight.apple.com/join/QGMY7CtU

comments.author: bestof-games
comments.body: Turns out Claude used godot for the CGI in the beginning and not blender
